title: Chapter 433
paragraphs: Chapter 433
Episode 125. Attackers, Brothers (1)
Steam billowed from the large pot. A pleasant aroma and bubbles rose from the seafood inside, such as crabs, shrimp, abalone, and octopus.
Seafood stew.
It was the favorite dish of Yuria, the only daughter of Kashmir and Alisa, since she was two years old.
Now nine years old, she couldn't attend school due to various reasons, but she spent her days neither lonely nor bored with Enya's younger sister Pinte (and the old dog Pupi), and Zet's son Kou.
Yuria especially loved moments like this, when children and adults gathered together to cook and eat seafood stew.
"Seafood stew, seafood stew."
Because of Yuria, all the children sang this strange song. Naturally, the sight was so cute that even Veris, who was usually perceived as a witch by the children, couldn't help but smile.
Especially when Kashmir and Alisa saw Yuria like this, they often felt a hot and intense emotion, as if something like butter was melting in their hearts.
'If it weren't for Jin, Yuria would have...'
'What a great blessing it is to see our daughter like this.'
As they scooped seafood stew into the bowls of their daughter and the children they considered as their own, the couple couldn't help but be moved.
"Eat up, kids. Make sure to chew well so you don't get sick."
"Yes!"
The adults clinked their glasses while watching the children eat. It was truly a harmonious moment.
"Having been able to save Yuria is one thing, but without Jin, this scene would not have existed."

"That's right, Lord Kashmir. We have become a family gathered together thanks to him, people who would have never met otherwise. Ah, sweet, sweet. The taste of alcohol is amazing after such a long time. It's a pity that he's not here though..."
After the attack on Gwamhong Castle, Tican's colleagues were enjoying their first leisurely time.
During their stay at Gwamhong Castle, they had a mountain of unhandled tasks and information to investigate.
"It's a shame that Jin is not here today."
As Yuria spoke, the children and colleagues all nodded in agreement.
"Aunt Strawberry Pie too."
"And Navi."
"Yeah, we miss them too. Is it delicious?"
"Yes, it is."
"Jin is supervising the Guardian Knight promotion exam, right?"

"That's right, Miss Enya. As expected, you know his schedule. It seems he wants to keep the Guardian Knight promotion from being solely determined by the Elders. Murakan said he would also attend to support Jin's statement."

Although the colleagues couldn't see the scene directly, they could easily imagine Murakan interfering. After all, he was the guardian deity of the royal family and the great Black Dragon, making a fuss.
"In the world, Murakan might be the only one who can scold the Runkandel Knights."
"He's been itching to roll the Council of Elders like that too."
As their colleagues chuckled, they seemed to feel a bit of regret.
They felt sorry that Jin, Murakan, and Gilliman couldn't experience this warm and cozy moment together.
"Next time, we should invite the Ghost Captain along with Jin to have a meal together."
"At first, he really acted like a mad dog, but I heard that he risked his life to protect Jin this time as well. He's quite a fitting successor."
"Jet, if you say that somewhere else, you might disappear without anyone knowing. I let it slide because it was cute, but Rataprochi isn't that kind of person."
"If he were here, at least a few fingers would've disappeared. Do you think the Ghost Captain would just let it slide?"
At Kujan and Veris's words, Jet responded nonchalantly.
"I'm just trying to act tough at times like this. Why are you guys so nitpicky? Come to think of it, you guys are my successors too."
On the other hand, Julian, who was sitting next to them, seemed to silently nod in agreement as he looked at Jet.
His guardian dragon, Kaltor, still hadn't woken up despite Quicantel feeding it a powerful elixir daily.
However, Julian had become very friendly with all of his colleagues since the day Jin brought back Ozdok's betrayal.
As various conversations were going back and forth, Alisa brought more drinks and looked at her colleagues.
"After today, we'll be busy again for a while. You all know that Jin is quite worried about Tichan, right?"
As she said, Tichan had been one of Jin's biggest concerns lately.
After the declaration of independence, the internal strife had intensified, and there had been psychological warfare with the emperor. Zipple and Kinzel also continued to show unsettling movements.
By now, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that everyone in the world knew Tichan was part of Jin's faction, so it wouldn't be surprising if they were attacked at any moment.
"Fortunately, Runkandel can't directly attack us thanks to Jin. He said he would support us with the Ghost Army's troops soon, but we can't just rely on Jin. We must prepare ourselves."
Of course, those who were residing in Tichan possessed power that exceeded that of an average small country's army.
However, their individual strength was outstanding, but the problem was that the number of combatants was too small compared to the small countries.
"The war and disaster preparedness system that Jin has been preparing since he was a candidate is about to be completed."

"But that alone is not enough, dear. Besides, that system is specialized for escape and counterattack, not defense. Hm, I wonder if I should find some abandoned juniors from the imperial family and raise them again."
"Special mission dropouts are too dangerous."
"I know, I just said it out of frustration. If I had my way, I'd like to hire even the mercenary Amela."
Amela, a mercenary from the Gaipa Army, was a figure who competed with the Black King Brigade for the position of one of the world's three greatest mercenaries.
"I don't know about Amela, but I've been considering the Black King Brigade. I need to meet with the Black King Brigade leader before Jin arrives."
Creak-.
As Kasimir finished speaking, someone approached the group with a brisk, cheerful stride.
"Dessert, special Litra cookies are here! The irresistibly delicious and crunchy texture that's too dangerous for children to eat!"
It was Latry. With his appearance, the children were instantly captivated, and the adults' mouths watered.
"Give me!"
"Please!"
As the children rushed forward, Latry smiled contentedly.
However, moments later, Latry, who was handing out cookies, was startled and turned his gaze to Yuria.
Yuria, unlike the children, didn't rush to get a cookie and was staring into the void with empty eyes.
"Yu, Yuria!"
As Latry shouted in a desperate voice, his colleagues could intuitively sense it.
That Yuria was experiencing the power of Azmil.
Although she had improved significantly since she was very young, Yuria still couldn't fully control the power of Azmil. It was a side effect of seeing too many futures during her infancy.
Latry quickly tried to start 'resonance,' but it wasn't as simple as when Yuria was very young.
"Latry, is Yuria okay!?"
"I think I have to transform into my true form to enter……."
"No, it's okay, Latry."
It was Yuria's voice. She was still staring at the unfolding future in her head, but unlike before, she seemed to be aware of the boundary between what she was 'seeing' and the present.
"Can you hear my voice, Yuria?"
"Yes, I can hear you."
"Are you in pain?"
"I don't see that yet."
Latry and his colleagues exchanged glances.
Soon, Latry sat in front of Yuria, closed his eyes, and still didn't perform resonance. Instead, he calmly asked Yuria what she was seeing.
"Yuria, tell me what you see."
"Tican…"
Yuria answered in a drowsy, hazy voice.
"Where in Tican? Our mansion, the café, the streets?"
"The whole. I see the whole… as if I'm looking from afar."
"Are you riding something? Like Murakan, or me?"
"Neither."
"Then what do you think it is?"
There was no answer for a while. It was a result of her concentration to figure out the exact background of the viewpoint shown by Azmil's power.
"A boat… a small boat. And."
Kyaaak!
Suddenly, Yuria screamed and opened her eyes.
Latry and his colleagues hugged Yuria at the same time, and she seemed to be trembling as if she had seen a very frightening scene.
"Tican."
Yuria continued with a trembling voice.
"It's going to be attacked."
"When?"
"Now."
Kwaang…!
As soon as Yuria finished speaking, a distant explosion was heard from outside the mansion.
There was a faint vibration as if a small earthquake had occurred.
Something with considerable power was striking the outer walls of the free city.
"Is it a cannon? A magic bomb?"
Jet instinctively looked out the window and yelled, but Quicantel and the unmanned ones already knew it wasn't that.
What was attacking the free city was the unmanned swordsmen. There were several of them with a 9-star rating or higher.
"Evacuate the children to a safe place and prepare for battle, everyone. They're not ordinary enemies. Contact Jin and the Ghost Corps right away!"
As Quicantel shouted, explosions and vibrations continued to be heard.
In the central training field of the Sword Garden, the guardian knights were taking their promotion exams in a solemn atmosphere.

Jin and Murakan were sitting on the opposite side of the elders, evaluating them. The position was chosen not only to evaluate the guardian knights but also to give scores to the elders evaluating them.

"The elder guys, if it weren't for you, they would have promoted only the ones that perfectly suited their taste. It's a problem that there are too many geniuses in the family. With such management, outstanding knights are overflowing and rotting, tsk."
"Anyway, those who couldn't get promoted despite their outstanding skills were going back to their respective classes. Hmm, that friend doesn't look bad."
While Jin and Murakan were examining the best of the best, someone desperately found the training field.
Creak!
The one who opened the door and entered was the butler, Petro.
Petro tried to maintain a calm expression so as not to be noticed by the enemy, but Jin saw through his anxious and uneasy heart.
'Young Master, we have received an emergency signal from Tican.'
The moment Petro approached and whispered the news, Jin almost failed to hide his expression.
Instead, Jin calmly asked about the situation.
'What exactly is the content?'
'It's said to be a situation where unmanned swordsmen above 9-star are invading. There was no additional signal yet.'
If there were no additional signals by the time they reached the teleportation gate, it meant that the situation was so urgent that they couldn't even send that.
'Did you contact the gatekeeper?'
'Of course.'
'We're leaving right away. And among my friendly forces, were there any currently near Tican?'
It seemed like a terrible thing would happen if there weren't any.
Fortunately, or should it be called a silver lining, Petro gave this answer.
'Daytona and Heytona young masters have been in the vicinity of Tican for a few days, waiting to meet you.'
